title: Create an account and arrive in an empty private collection
description: A new visitor can register with valid credentials and is automatically signed in to an empty private collection.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Click the link to create an account
Fill in the username field with a new valid username
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Fill in the password confirmation field with the same valid password
Submit the registration form
Verify the user lands on the collection page
Verify the new account's empty collection is displayed

title: Open the collection page while signed out and reach the login screen
description: A signed-out visitor trying to access the private collection is redirected to sign in with the next destination preserved.

steps.description: Navigate to /collection
Verify the user is redirected to the login page
Verify the next destination for the collection page is preserved

title: New account signup lands in an empty private collection

title: Registered user stays signed in after returning to the collection
description: A signed-in user remains authenticated when revisiting the collection page and reloading it.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with an existing username
Fill in the password field with the matching password
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the collection page
Wait for the collection page to finish loading
Reload the page
Verify the user remains signed in
Verify the collection page is still displayed
